title: Toll Brothers Luxury Living Near the Beach
summary: Discover the benefits of homes with nearby beach access in Toll Brothers luxury communities across the country.
body_markdown:
Last updated on September 8th, 2026


From tranquil lakeside retreats to lively master-planned communities located just minutes from the ocean, Toll Brothers builds exquisite homes that put you closer to the water. In a Toll Brothers community with nearby beach access, you can experience the coastal breeze through your open windows in a gorgeous new home.


### Quick Summary


- Toll Brothers combines luxury living with proximity to the beach to facilitate daily activities like kayaking, coastal walks, and enjoying the ocean’s beauty.
- Resort-style amenities elevate coastal living, with many Toll Brothers communities offering pools, fitness centers, clubhouses, and even docks.
- Toll Brothers offers low-maintenance living, with services such as lawn care and trash removal, supporting a lock-and-leave lifestyle near the beach.
- Toll Brothers builds in sought-after coastal destinations, including Florida, California, Massachusetts, Michigan, and South Carolina.


[Everly at Civita by Toll Brothers in San Diego, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Everly-at-Civita)


## Benefits of Toll Brothers Communities Near the Beach


### Easy Beach Access


Living in a Toll Brothers community near a lake, river, or the ocean makes it more convenient to take advantage of the numerous activities and benefits of living near the water. Walks by the sea, kayaking, meditating in tranquil settings, and so much more can become part of your daily routine. Enjoy a colorful beach sunrise and return in time for breakfast in your well-equipped kitchen, or spend a full day on the water knowing that home and all its comforts are nearby.


[Seven Shores by Toll Brothers in Naples, FL](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/Florida/Seven-Shores)


### Premier Community Amenities


Many Toll Brothers communities offer upscale amenities that enhance everyday living and pair well with the beach lifestyle, such as:


- Resort-style pools where you can soak up the sun, swim laps, or just enjoy cooling off with family and friends.
- State-of-the-art fitness centers and sports courts that support your wellness goals and encourage friendly competition.
- Elegant clubhouses and social spaces for gathering with neighbors and forging new connections.
- Docks for launching watercrafts, fishing, or observing nature.


These thoughtfully designed amenities enhance coastal living, fostering an engaging and exciting environment.


[Cascadia at Grande Dunes by Toll Brothers in Myrtle Beach, SC](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/South-Carolina/Cascadia-at-Grande-Dunes)


### Low-Maintenance Living Options


If you’re looking for ways to make the most of your free time and spend more hours enjoying the water or the shore, low-maintenance communities are an ideal option. With features such as trash removal, lawn maintenance, and snow removal included, Toll Brothers communities[with low-maintenance living](https://www.tollbrothers.com/blog/low-maintenance-living) allow you to spend more time relishing the beach. Communities that offer low-maintenance living can be especially appealing to retirees, frequent travelers, and snowbirds who value the ability to come and go with ease.


## Ideal Toll Brothers Locations Near the Beach


Toll Brothers offers luxury living in prime locations, including vibrant towns along[Florida’s](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Florida) coasts, golden[California](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/California) shorelines, seaside settings in[Massachusetts](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Massachusetts) , lakeside sanctuaries in[Michigan](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Michigan) , and charming coastal areas in[South Carolina](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/South-Carolina) .


Along with expertly crafted new homes, many of these communities showcase features such as stunning views, lock-and-leave living, outdoor living spaces, and proximity to major roadways.


[Toll Brothers at The Reserve at Crystal Lake in Commerce Township, MI](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/Michigan/Toll-Brothers-at-The-Reserve-at-Crystal-Lake)


For more ways to personalize your home, find the right location, and cater to the lifestyle you desire, explore the[Luxury Lifestyle](https://www.tollbrothers.com/blog/category/luxury-lifestyle) category on our blog.
